reactor_type: flow-type in-house built hot-wall ALD reactor
evidence: The metal precursor and ozone pulse lengths were varied between 2 and 5 s. The reactor pressure was in the range of 1.95–2.60 mbar. The cycle times used for the growth of samples further subjected to magnetometry were 5-15-5-5 s for the sequence FeCp2 pulse-purge-O3 pulse-purge.
